svg.aria-label: val-ark: An offline-first mirror that fills a disk with open-source tools, AI models and Wikipedia, then serves it over local wifi.
svg.title: val-ark: An offline-first mirror that fills a disk with open-source tools, AI models and Wikipedia, then serves it over local wifi.
svg.desc: A disk fills cell by cell from Val Ark's real catalogue (its 50 tool scripts, its extra-model table and its installer table), one of each kind first, as the Librarian plans it; then wifi arcs pulse as it serves the mirror to the local network. Drawn from mvalancy/val-ark at commit 0d2abb25ab73.
